admission: First real baseline lifecycle must succeed before admitting its skill counterpart. Pair 2 only if observed cost supports a complete pair plus 45-minute closeout. No cherry-picked successful reruns.
comparison_dimensions: Q3 residual information and matched controls
semantic_scoring: v3 contract frozen; model semantic calibration pending; no accepted P/R/F1 or composite capability score unless separately calibrated under the frozen policy
service_failure: Retain every launch. Capacity/auth/network failure is external missingness, not zero capability. No unrecorded rerun or replacement. Any technical diagnostic remains separate.
interpretation: At most two pairs on one real task; synthetic-dev skill transfer, not general ability improvement or RSI
